concepts.name: ref-01-cutaway-workshop
concepts.title: R1 · 층별 작업실
concepts.prompt:
Use attached image strictly as STYLE AND SPATIAL ORGANIZATION REFERENCE: cozy detailed isometric cutaway rooms, chunky pixel/voxel craft, warm timber, layered depth, glowing crystals, readable walls and floors. Ignore its Korean video subtitle and do not copy subtitle. Create ONE 16:9 image of a finished DEPTH AI software-development app using this reference-inspired FULLY 3D environment to navigate a LARGE real software project. Every ROOM is a FUNCTIONAL SOFTWARE MODULE; room groups are subsystems. The spatial architecture MUST encode the project, not just decorate it. Actual volumetric rooms, visible wall thickness and stacked floors, strong isometric/three-quarter camera, depth, occlusion, cast shadows. Not a flat map. Show the whole project with 8 labelled districts and many small rooms. Primary labels 'Gameplay', 'Characters', 'Economy', 'World', 'UI', 'Network', 'Save', 'Audio'. Each district contains around 8-15 represented room modules, distant districts summarize more modules. Minimal connections: visible corridors mean dependencies, cross-system routes bundled and highlighted only on selection. One 'Wallet' room is shared by Reward and Shop, never duplicated.

Select 'Reward' room in Economy and open its roof/front wall toward viewer; nearby dependent rooms stay visible. It has a gift icon and small source-file artifact 'RewardPolicy.cs' on a workstation, not a giant fake code wall. An anchored CLEAN legible inspector at screen right displays 'Reward', '생성 이유: 퍼즐 성공 시 재화 지급', '설계 근거: 퍼즐과 경제 로직 분리', 'RewardPolicy.cs', '검증: 4 tests'. Architectural ornaments are restrained: room contents suggest roles, but semantic labels and dependency paths do the explanatory work. A small 15% live game viewport at screen right shows an explorer in an island game with '+100' coins; it is visibly the TARGET RUNNING PROJECT, distinct from the architectural visualization. Tiny top brand DEPTH AI, breadcrumb 'Project > Economy > Reward', search, orbit controls. This must feel like a credible spatial software IDE interpreted through the user's cozy voxel reference, not a screenshot of a generic building game. Crisp clean text, high-quality detailed stylized 3D render, pixel-influenced textures and restrained charming craftsmanship. No people walking through architecture needed. No copied reference watermark or subtitles. Conceptual metrics only.
Direction R1: ONE LARGE MULTI-LEVEL CUTAWAY WORKSHOP STRUCTURE like the reference. An organically stepped underground timber-and-stone complex, seen from above and front at 35-degree angle; dozens of rooms visible on 4 levels, organized into 8 subsystems with architectural borders and clearly labelled lintels. Economy's room group is opened and subtly pulled toward camera, showing Reward, Shop, Wallet with one warm glowing path into the shared Wallet. Other districts remain compact, dimmer, all visible in the overview. Beautiful amber lanterns, cool teal crystals, warm cedar floors, dark stone outside. Show structural layers and nested organization clearly. Plenty of visual hierarchy, avoid messy decoration. This is the closest reinterpretation of the reference. Small label 'R1 / Cutaway workshop'.
